C1303.title: TeamPCP Exploits Stolen CI/CD Credentials to Breach Checkmarx GitHub Actions
C1303.summary: Around March 19, 2026, TeamPCP used stolen CI credentials to compromise Checkmarx-related GitHub Actions workflows and implant credential-stealing malware into two workflows, potentially enabling supply-chain attacks. The source supports TeamPCP, stolen CI credentials, two workflows, and credential theft; lateral movement and persistence consequences should only be included after adding supporting sources.

references.title: TeamPCP Hacks Checkmarx GitHub Actions Using Stolen CI Credentials
